fr_shopping_noun.hook: The PENGUIN ("shoh-PING") goes SHOPPING with bags dangling from both flippers.

fr_copie_noun.hook: "koh-PEA": the parrot squawks "COPY!" and types out a perfect COPY of the letter.

fr_bourg_noun.hook: A model MARKET TOWN of red-roofed toy houses, so quiet it is a BORE ("BOOR").
fr_bourg_noun.why: The painting shows the model houses only; no fountain or yawning boy.

fr_debattre_verb.hook: With a painted mustache, Monsieur Verbe DEBATES the price of the lot, finger raised (day-BAH-tr).

fr_colporteur_noun.why: RECS p12 plan move (route raccoon removed); human peddler on the right as requested; ventes is full, so painted in the florist's courtyard.

fr_saoul_adj.note: An informal adult word for intoxicated by alcohol; also spelled soûl.
ex: Après la fête, il était trop saoul pour conduire : il a pris un taxi.
After the party he was too intoxicated to drive, so he took a taxi.

fr_ivrogne_adj.note: Someone who drinks too much alcohol; insulting when said about a person, so use it with care.
ex: Dans la chanson, un vieux marin ivrogne chante faux.
In the song, an old sailor who drinks too much sings out of tune.
fr_ivrogne_adj.en: habitual heavy drinker; given to heavy drinking
